_comment: The Internal Prompt Registry (ADR-0012, 28-ai-platform.md). Prompts are Signora's language and ship as versioned repository artifacts, reviewed like code — the same ownership criterion that placed the business event taxonomy, the scoring model and the opportunity policy here. `fingerprint` is the SHA-256 of name, version and text: it is the artifact's identity, and the loader refuses to start if the file on disk disagrees with it. A released version is never edited in place, because every result recorded against it was produced by the text this hash names; a change is always a new version. `evaluations` is append-only and deliberately outside the fingerprint — they are observations *about* a prompt, not part of what it is, so measuring one must not change its identity. A prompt is usable only with the exact (model, dataset) pairs it has passed (ADR-0028): explanation_narration@1 has passed none, so it is currently unusable by design, and T120 is what earns it a release.
